title: Coalition team up with Labor to pass 20% gas reservation scheme for Australia’s largest exporters
summary:
Coalition voted in Senate to pass government’s final major piece of legislation for 2026, denying Greens’ bid for 25% tax on exports

  • Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast

A federal gas reservation scheme requiring Australia’s largest exporters to keep up to 20% of their product for domestic use will go ahead with the Coalition’s support.

The opposition voted with the government in the Senate on Thursday night in a late sitting, giving Labor the numbers it needed.
